parts.html: The K-16 standard model is a green L-shaped kitchen in a neoclassical style. The fronts are solid-colored, and the cabinet shapes are simple.
Green fronts go well with light walls, wood, stone, and decor in warm neutral tones.
Neoclassical style borrows calm forms from classical design but does without excess ornament, so the K-16 suits a modern apartment as well as a house.
The layout is L-shaped, 4.6 linear meters along two adjoining walls: work surfaces, built-in appliances, cabinets. There is no island, so the free part of the room can go to a dining table.
All the fronts are foil-wrapped, with the top and bottom in the same shade of green.
The kitchen has a cargo pull-out. The doors close on Muller soft-close hinges, and the drawers run on Muller telescopic slides, also soft-close.
For your kitchen, the K-16 cabinet sizes and work surface configuration can be changed, and the shade of the fronts can be matched to your interior.
